name: Privatzimmer Dietzel
beschreibung: The Privatzimmer Dietzel is located on the outskirts of Kufstein, not far from the town centre. The inn offers classic Tyrolean hospitality with simple, clean rooms and a small restaurant. Guests appreciate the quiet location and the personal attention from the Dietzel family. Breakfast is included, and regional dishes are also served. The Kufstein Fortress can be reached in a few minutes, as can the local recreation areas on the Inn.
